{{Quote|Mesa cause maybe one, two-y little bitty axadentes, huh? Yud say boom de gasser, den crashin der bosses heyblibber, den banished.|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''heyblibber''' was a model of [[submarine]] used by the [[Gungan]]s. [[Boss]] [[Rugor Nass]], the leader of the [[Gungan High Council]], owned a heyblibber until [[Jar Jar Binks]] crashed the prized submarine, after which Nass ejected the clumsy Gungan from [[Otoh Gunga]] and enacted the "[[nocombackie law]]," which threatened Binks with pain of being pounded to [[death]] should he ever return.<ref name="Boss Nass" />
